_note: ForgeMiner 1.8.4: official GitHub release, SHA-256 matches the one published in the release notes; Windows Defender doesn't flag it (SRBMiner 3.7.1 was quarantined as Trojan:Win32/Ravartar!rfn). Closed source; the app only downloads the official release URL with its pinned SHA-256, never a rehosted copy (user, Oct 4: no need to ask the developer). Flags confirmed by a live run on the user's RTX 4070 SUPER on Kryptex (Oct 4): 122.9 TH/s at 196 W, share accepted, worker visible in Kryptex's public API. Temperature limit 83/75 C: an 80 C limit would cycle on a normal gaming card (it reached 79 C in 3 minutes). devFee is per algorithm (%). BzMiner v100.45 (Oct 4): official GitHub release, SHA-256 matches GitHub's digest, not flagged by Defender on download or unpack (WildRig 0.51.3 was: Trojan:Script/CoinMiner!rfn). Used for Quantus on AMD and Intel Arc. Not yet run: its dev fee is only printed at startup, and --devices numbering (it counts every device it finds) and --set http_port need a live check on an AMD PC.
